defects.claim: the GH-5346 timeout salvage path passes nil gates to appendAcceptanceEvidence, so it can never reuse gate output even though the gates just ran and passed in that run
defects.evidence: runner.go:3157 sets `result.QualityGates = r.buildQualityGatesResult(outcome, 0)` right before runner.go:3163 calls `r.pushAndCreatePRAfterTimeout(finCtx, ...)`. On that path `make build/test/lint` evidence bullets still re-run every gate, though the evidence budget now caps how long that takes

defects.claim: the runner test only covers the shared PRCreator branch (`task.SourceAdapter = "linear"`, runner.go:7260). The gh CLI branch (runner.go:7312, `git.CreatePR`), which is the GitHub path from the incident, and the SDK branch (runner.go:7236) get the same re-derivation, but no test fails if either one is removed

reuse uses the gate output captured before self-review, and self-review runs between the gates and evidence and can change code (issue timeline: "intent judge and self-review to 17:03:03"). In that case the "(from the quality-gate run)" output describes an earlier tree. The issue asks for this reuse, but the PR body gives no sign that the output may be stale

`emit(evidenceEventReused, i+1)` fires once per reused command, not once per evidence step. An item with three reused gate commands logs three WARN lines, while the issue asks for "One WARN log line when evidence reuse or budget exhaustion happens"

The new re-derivation before PR creation only adds time when the task deadline has already passed. If the task ctx is still alive with a few seconds left, CreatePR keeps that short deadline. The guard is `if ctx.Err() == context.DeadlineExceeded {` and every other case is `return context.WithCancel(ctx)`. So a deadline that expires during the three CreatePR attempts at runner.go:7239 still fails them; only the recovery ref is saved by the refresh at runner.go:400.

If the budget runs out partway through an item that has several commands, the skipped commands are pasted inside the "## Evidence" code block and do not appear as "Not verified" lines. `allErrored = false` from an earlier command that ran or was reused leaves NotVerifiedReason empty, so the rewrite and the WARN emit at acceptance_evidence_run.go:836 and :848 never fire for that item.

The issue asks for "One WARN log line". The loop `for _, c := range res.Commands { if c.FromQualityGate { emit(evidenceEventReused, i+1)` logs once per reused command, so the standard make build, make test, make lint bullet produces three WARN lines.

`task.SourceAdapter = "linear"` sends the runner test only through the shared-creator branch (runner.go:7276). If the re-derivation is removed from the gh CLI branch (runner.go:7312) or the SDK branch (runner.go:7236), which carry the observed GH-5864 failure, no test fails.

not_verified: The issue says this repo's real quality-gate command strings match the evidence argv (e.g. `make test`). I only found the built-in defaults at internal/quality/types.go:185/195/205 (`Command: "make build"` etc.). The deployed config on the box is not in the checkout

The three mutation acceptance bullets are listed under the PR's "## Not verified" as "freeform mutation, run manually". No mutation run is pasted, so it is unconfirmed that each test fails when its guarded line is removed.
